title: Immigration Adviser for Liverpool | Visa Help | UVS
description: Immigration adviser for Liverpool clients, IAA-regulated: spouse visas, Skilled Worker, ILR, citizenship and sponsor licences, by phone, video or in Manchester.
intro: Looking for an immigration adviser for Liverpool? Unique Visa Services has helped clients across Merseyside since 2008. We work with you by phone, video call and email, or you can visit our Manchester office.

sections.heading: Your immigration adviser for Liverpool, without the travel
sections.text:
You don’t need to come to Manchester to work with us. Most Liverpool clients have their consultation by phone or video call, send documents by email, WhatsApp or post, and only travel for their biometrics appointment. If you’d rather meet face to face, our office at 61 Mosley Street is a short walk from Manchester Piccadilly and Victoria stations.

We’re regulated by the Immigration Advice Authority (IAA), reference F200700144, so you know you’re dealing with a qualified adviser.

sections.heading: Immigration and visa help for Liverpool clients
sections.text:
Merseyside clients come to us for every kind of application, but spouse visas, ILR and British citizenship make up most of our Liverpool work. With the University of Liverpool and Liverpool John Moores in the city, we also see many students and graduates, and employers around the port and the city’s hospitals looking to sponsor skilled staff.

We help with:
- [Spouse and partner visas](/uk-spouse-visas/) and [extensions](/uk-spouse-visa-extension/)
- [Skilled Worker visas](/skilled-worker-visa-formally-tier-t2-general/) and [sponsor licences](/sponsor-licence-application/)
- [Indefinite Leave to Remain](/indefinite-leave-to-remain-ilr/) and [British citizenship](/british-citizenship/)
- [Student](/student-visa-uk/), [Graduate](/post-study-work-visa/) and [visit visas](/uk-visit-visa/)
- Travel visas, [document legalisation](/document-legalisation/) and Indian passport services

sections.heading: Biometrics appointments for Liverpool applicants
sections.text:
Liverpool has its own UKVCAS service point, so clients on Merseyside can usually give their biometrics locally for extensions, ILR and citizenship.

We tell you exactly which appointment to book, check your documents are complete and in the right order before you go, and let you know if you can use the UK Immigration: ID Check app instead.

sections.heading: Getting started
sections.text:
1. Call or message us, or fill in our [contact form](/contact-us/), with a few lines about your situation.
2. We book a consultation by phone or video at a time that suits you, including early mornings.
3. We confirm your options, the documents you need and our fixed fee in writing.
4. You send your documents, and we prepare and check your application.

Whether you’re in Liverpool city centre or anywhere in Merseyside, the process is the same, and you deal with the same adviser throughout.

sections.heading: How we work
sections.text:
- A consultation first, so you know if you qualify before you pay for an application
- A fixed fee agreed in writing, the same wherever you live
- A clear document checklist for your situation
- Every page checked against the current rules before anything is submitted
- Updates from us until you have a decision

sections.heading: Free tools to check where you stand
sections.text: Before you book, you can use our free [spouse visa income calculator](/spouse-visa-income-calculator/), [UK visa cost calculator](/uk-visa-cost-calculator/), [ILR eligibility checker](/am-i-eligible-for-ilr/), [Skilled Worker jobs checker](/skilled-worker-jobs/) and [Life in the UK mock test](/life-in-the-uk-mock-test/). See all the [areas we serve](/areas-we-serve/).

faqs.q: Do I need to visit your office from Liverpool?
faqs.a: No. Most clients work with us entirely by phone, video call, email and post. You’re welcome to visit our Manchester office if you prefer.

faqs.q: Is your fee higher for Liverpool clients?
faqs.a: No. Our fee is the same wherever you live, and we agree it in writing before we start.

faqs.q: Where will my biometrics appointment be?
faqs.a: Liverpool has its own UKVCAS service point, so clients on Merseyside can usually give their biometrics locally for extensions, ILR and citizenship.

faqs.q: Are you a regulated immigration adviser?
faqs.a: Yes. Unique Visa Services is regulated by the Immigration Advice Authority, reference F200700144.

faqs.q: Can an immigration adviser for Liverpool help if I’ve been refused?
faqs.a: Yes. We look at the refusal letter, explain why it happened and advise whether to reapply, ask for an administrative review or appeal.
